records.text: A Sifreldar storm maiden who fights with storm magic, calling a Storm Cloud during combat.
A Sifreldar runekeeper who fights with frost magic and turns to a revitalizing rune when badly hurt.
Torseg the Exiled is a lone giant who sleeps until disturbed, then attacks with a War Stomp and a backbreaking strike.
A Niffelem frost giant whose heavy blows can debilitate those who engage it.
Kirgaraak is a huge, captured yeti kept in chains for mount training. Astrid calls him the largest yeti they have captured in years and warns trainees to leave if he overpowers them.
A frostworg, a beast that attacks with a biting chill and mauls its prey in combat.
A Brunnhildar challenger found in the Snowdrift Plains, this fighter punctuates its idle moments with a random gesture. Its title gives it a clear combat role.

Valduran the Stormborn is a named Stormforged leader whom Bouldercrag identifies as the enemy behind the iron colossus project. He taunts Bouldercrag as a rock and sneers at the idea that he could think; when challenged, Valduran says nothing can stop the colossus from being completed. His dialogue gives him a confident, contemptuous edge, while his ambition is tied to the unfinished weapon.

Bouldercrag's account places Stormforged Taskmasters among the iron dwarves holding captive mechagnomes at work in the Frozen Mine. Their recorded taunts belittle constructs as scrap, tin, and slag, and they use lightning-charged attacks.
A Stormforged Champion appears in the Snowdrift Plains. In battle, it uses Lightning Charged, fitting the combat role signaled by its title.
A Stormforged Magus in the Snowdrift Plains uses Lightning Shield while out of combat, marking its spellcasting role.

Thorim describes the Stormforged Iron Giants as part of Fjorn's iron force besieging Dun Niffelem, and places the giants at Fjorn's Anvil. They fight with Shockwave; Thorim sees their defeat as a way to weaken the siege and begin repairing ties with the frost giants.
A Stormforged artificer is an iron dwarf artisan at Narvir’s Cradle. The artisans build a weapon for the Stormforged effort, making their work a threat to Bouldercrag’s defenders.
A Stormforged raider is one of the iron dwarves attacking Bouldercrag’s Refuge. The raiders and reavers are among the attackers the refuge’s defenders are trying to repel.
A Stormforged war golem is a construct serving the Stormforged forces around Bouldercrag’s Refuge. It fights with a heavy Storm Punch.
A Stormforged reaver is one of the iron dwarves attacking Bouldercrag’s Refuge. Reavers join raiders among the attackers pressing the refuge’s defenders.

A captive mechagnome laborer is malfunctioning and still echoes its imposed directives: shut down, return to the Inventor’s Library, or help defeat the iron dwarves. Its clipped, mechanical words suit a worker trapped under Stormforged control; an offered chance to free the mine’s slaves makes its captivity clear.
A mechagnome laborer is a worker found in the Stormforged-controlled area around Bouldercrag’s Refuge.
A Snowdrift Jormungar is a beast that uses Corrosive Poison in combat.
The Sparksocket AA Cannon is an anti-aircraft cannon.
An Ironwool Mammoth is a beast that casts Ironwool Coat in combat.
A Savage Hill Scavenger is a humanoid that uses Bone Toss in combat.
A Snowblind Devotee is a humanoid devotee that casts Blind Faith when badly wounded.
A Garm Watcher is a humanoid that responds to attackers with Magnataur Charge.
A Crystalweb Weaver is a spider found around Crystalweb Cavern. It uses Crystal Chains against nearby foes.

A Crystalweb Spitter is a spider found around Crystalweb Cavern. Tore Rumblewrench identifies the cavern’s spiders as threats to his planned mining operation, and this creature uses Crystal Spike in combat.
A Snowblind Digger is a Snowblind vrykul encountered in the surrounding area. It fights with Sunder Armor.
A Hyldnir Overseer is a vrykul overseer who fights with Battle Shout.
A Captive Vrykul is one of the vrykul held captive in the area.

Ricket is a quick-witted, upbeat organizer at K3, coordinating work around the camp’s sapper squad and teleporter. She turns a food shortage and nearby gnoll threat into jobs for newcomers, then jokes about elaborate plans before sending them into the fight. Her banter is playful; her instructions about enemies are blunt.

Janks is stuck watching the turrets and sounds weary and frustrated about it. He hopes someone has come to free him, then suspects the “heartless lout” who left him there has instead sent someone to retrieve tools. With no rescue in sight, he resignedly settles back to keeping an eye on the turrets.

Tore Rumblewrench says he heads K3’s mining operation, though he expects to take over the nearby cavern shortly. He speaks with easy enthusiasm, wants its spiders cleared before the move, and is trying to obtain ore samples to calibrate processing machines. When the miners he sent in do not return, he asks for help retrieving samples from the snobolds.

Jeer Sparksocket is K3’s excitable explosives tinkerer, building land mines for Ricket and laying a minefield guarded by turrets. He can misplace his own tools, then brag that his new mines show unmatched brilliance. He jokes about his mishaps and wonders where Dim and Janks have gone.

Gino is an explosives specialist with a flair for dramatic tests: he calls his perfected charge his “baby,” delights in the blast, and jokes that his inventions blow up. He recruits help for an assault on Frostgut’s cave, then says his sappers will handle the remaining magnataurs and sends the adventurer back to Ricket.
Goblin Sappers are goblin demolitionists working around K3. The name describes a sapper group rather than a distinct named individual.

An injured goblin miner in Crystalweb Cavern, poisoned by a bite from an unusually large, brightly colored spider. He asks for an Icetip venom sac so Ricket can make an antidote, fears Tore will not come, and tries to lie still as if dead. He wants help leaving soon; he plans to take the sac to Ricket and then collapse.

Thorim grieves Sif and is tormented by visions of her, seeking to avenge her and honor her memory. He aims to reclaim his home at the Terrace of the Makers from his brother Loken. To renew his strength, he tries to mend his friendship with the frost giants and asks King Jokkum about his lost hammer, Krolmir, and reforging his armor. He also hopes to reunite with Veranus, the riding drake he released years ago.
A frigid proto-drake.
An Icetip Crawler. It uses Icetip Poison in combat.
One of the goblin men taken from a K3 expedition by the Hyldnir and held in Sifreldar. Once freed, he is eager to escape and thanks the person who helped him.
A wild Ice Steppe Rhino that attacks by charging targets that come within range.

Gretchen Fizzlespark asks for the K3 expedition's captured men and stolen equipment to be recovered. She also reveals that her brother Zeev remains missing in the Forlorn Mine, and thanks the rescuer for returned equipment.
An improved land mine, an explosive trap that detonates when a victim comes within close range.
An Earthen Defender, an earthbound guardian found in the Storm Peaks. Its named role is defense.

Lok'lira is a Yrkvinn illusion practitioner imprisoned by the Hyldnir in the Forlorn Mine. She bargains for help escaping, offering to disguise the player among the Hyldnir and help find their green-skinned friend; she says she will meet them in Brunnhildar Village.

Fjorn is a named enemy at Fjorn's Anvil whose iron giants besiege Dun Niffelem. Thorim calls for his defeat to weaken the assault on the Sons of Hodir, and Fjorn fights with fire and earth magic while supported by summoned earthen.
An undead revenant that attacks in combat by casting Seething Flames.
Overseer Syra patrols the Forlorn Mine and holds the runes belonging to Lok'lira the Crone, a Yrkvinn held prisoner by the Hyldnir. In combat, Syra uses Backhand and Whirlwind.

Goblin Zeev Fizzlespark is caught up in the Hyldsmeet and needs rescuing from the Hyldnir. When he gets a chance to speak, he thanks his rescuer and says he wants to get away from the “crazy blue women.”
The body of a dead frostworg; this creature represents a carcass rather than a living beast.
A dead frost giant, represented by a corpse rather than a living giant.
A humanoid known as a K3 Snow Runner in The Storm Peaks.
A Brunnhildar riding bear, identified as a mount rather than an individual character.
A Brunnhildar bearhandler who calls the Hyldsmeet sacred and says its victor is assured a lifetime beside Thorim.
A Garm watcher among the targets Ricket sends recruits to fight; it can use Magnataur Charge.
A Snowblind devotee among the targets Ricket sends recruits to fight; it can cast Blind Faith when near defeat.
A goblin sapper encountered in the Brunnhildar region.
A bear identified with Icemaw.

An injured Icemaw matriarch is a surviving wild bear sought in the Hibernal Cave, where ravenous jormungar have driven the bears close to extinction. Astrid hopes a rescued matriarch will prove a stronger fighter than captive-bred bears.
Grimes is a humanoid in the Storm Peaks.
Valkyrion aspirants are hostile humanoid inhabitants of the Valkyrion area. When badly wounded, an aspirant may cast Metanoia.

Nascent Val’kyr are winged creatures found around Valkyrion. They attack with Touch of the Val’kyr and Lash. Iva the Vengeful calls them traitors and says the Hyldnir view Valkyrion’s val’kyr as servants of the Lich King.

Brann Bronzebeard is a dwarf investigating Ulduar's archives and Norgannon's divided keystone, communicating with allies through a device associated with the Explorers' League. He has discovered conflict among the Titans' creations and warns that Horde–Alliance fighting could let Loken turn Ulduar's resources against both sides. Aware of Scout Vor'takh's reputation for ruthlessness, he questions whether the scout means to abduct him.

A Stormforged Pillager is an iron dwarf encountered as a hostile combatant in the valley near Frosthold. Fjorlin Frostbrow identifies iron dwarves as intruders and asks for them to be driven off; the pillager uses a lightning-charged attack.
The Blighted Proto-Drake is a drake creature.

Brijana is a Brunnhildar warrior who prizes glory in battle and tests whether challengers have the strength and courage for their trials. She trusts Icefang, her unarmored bear, after countless battles together, and expects courage from those she challenges. Her manner is stern and impatient with delay.

Yorg Stormheart is the Frostborn king at Frosthold, a respected warrior and a generous host to travelers. He is cautious about involving his people in outsiders’ affairs, but offers their help when a visitor proves strength and fierceness. He speaks in a Frostborn dialect.
Icefang is a named creature.
Ravenous Jormungar are among the creatures Astrid Bjornrittar says have overrun the Hibernal Cavern east of Brunnhildar; her contempt for them is her own view.
A Snowblind Follower is one of the attackers sent from Garm's Bane against K3. Its rough cries include “Grrrrr!” and “Me not afraid!”, while another boast falters into worry about a net.
Garm Invader is a combatant found at Garm's Bane.
Savage Hill Mystic is a Savage Hill combatant that casts Arcane Barrage in combat.
Savage Hill Brute is a Savage Hill combatant that uses Brute Force once in combat.
Stormrider is an elemental whose combat abilities include Forked Lightning and Stormstrike.
A proto-drake associated with the Hyldsmeet, found in the Storm Peaks.
A Brunnhildar prisoner in the Storm Peaks.
Dim Flathoof is a humanoid in the Storm Peaks.

Bailey trades sharp banter with Bellinger while they discuss getting past tools and mines. He objects when Bellinger calls him smaller and suggests tossing him across, taking the remark about his height as an insult and snapping back.

Bellinger talks with Bailey about getting past tools and mines, first suggesting they throw a rock at the tools, then proposing to toss Bailey because he is smaller and less likely to set off mines. Bailey takes offense at the implication about his height, and Bellinger responds with an idea of his own.

Archaeologist Andorin of the Explorers' League is pursuing Brann Bronzebeard's trail at Frosthold. He fears the iron dwarves will reach Brann first and recruits help to track him, including with a frosthound. When Brann's communicator is lost, Andorin can provide a replacement; his concern is finding Brann before the iron dwarves do.

At the Grom'arsh crash site, Boktar Bloodfury investigates Brann Bronzebeard's disappearance for the Horde, first seeking clues and a way to track him. After hearing from Brann, Boktar rejects Vor'takh's plan as contrary to the Horde's way and supports helping Brann oppose Loken and the iron dwarves, seeing him as a valuable ally in uncovering Ulduar's secrets.
A Stormforged tracker is a ranged combatant in the Storm Peaks, attacking with Shoot when engaged.
Tracker Thulin is a named tracker in the Storm Peaks, tied to the search for Brann's missing possessions.
A captive proto-drake is held in the Storm Peaks.
Skizzle Slickslide is a flight master who offers fast travel. When attacked, he summons an enraged gryphon and an enraged wyvern.
A Library Guardian voices computer diagnostics, including attempts to restore lost data. When attacked, it releases its rooted state.

Glorthal Stiffbeard is a Frostborn at Frosthold who sends visitors to search for missing scouts and push back the harpies threatening his people. He expects the scouts may have met a harsh fate, but still asks for news, and credits King Stormheart with making the Frostborn formidable fighters. His praise is personal: he calls the king the wisest and strongest leader he has known, adding a teasing remark about his peach-colored skin.
A Frostborn Axemaster stationed in the Frosthold area.
A Frostborn Iceshaper stationed in the Frosthold area.

Fjorlin Frostbrow is a seasoned Frostborn at Frosthold who speaks of the Stormcrest Eagles as longtime allies. He organizes work to feed them and ride with them against the increasingly aggressive stormpeak wyrms, and worries that iron dwarves may discover Frosthold. Yorg Stormheart entrusted him with a hammer, which Fjorlin asks others to return after using.

Lagnus is an Explorers' League expedition leader at Frosthold. He welcomes newcomers and has medical supplies delivered to the Frostborn in gratitude for their hospitality. He seeks King Stormheart's help with the keystone core and is impressed by Brann's discovery of Norgannon's Shell, praising both Brann and the person who brought it back.

Rork Sharpchin is an Explorers' League relic collector at Frosthold. He asks travelers to bring him relics found in the mountains and offers ale in return. His greeting celebrates treasure hunting and hearty ale.
Imogen is associated with the Explorers' League.
Faldorf Bitterchill is Frosthold's flight master, offering travelers fast air transport. When attacked, he summons an enraged gryphon and then an enraged wyvern.

Drom Frostgrip is a hermit who watches places sacred to the titans and remains loyal to their old ways. He often speaks with the keeper Creteus and has spent days searching for Norgannon's Core. Iron dwarves took his signet ring; he asks that it be recovered and shown to Creteus, who watches over the Engine of the Makers.
Databank Core is a mechanical databank among the Inventor's Library devices. Mimir hid information in the databanks, and an Inventor's Disk can retrieve hidden data from them.
Stormpeak Wyrms are proto-drakes driven to aggression after the iron dwarves captured Veranus, their brood mother. They have pushed into Stormcrest territory and are fighting its eagles.
A young Stormpeak drake, the hatchling sleeps out of combat; when roused into combat, it uses Wing Smash.
Kabarg Windtamer is a flight master who offers fast travel. If attacked, he summons an enraged gryphon and an enraged wyvern.
Hyeyoung Parka is a wind rider master who offers fast travel. She calls for guards; if attacked, she summons an enraged wyvern.

A Frostfeather Screecher is one of the harpies harassing the area around Frosthold. Glorthal Stiffbeard describes the Frostfeather harpies as repeatedly returning to aggression, and asks that their numbers be thinned so they will keep to themselves. This screecher uses a piercing cry in combat.

A Frostfeather Witch is one of the harpies harassing the area around Frosthold. Glorthal Stiffbeard describes the Frostfeather harpies as repeatedly returning to aggression, and asks that their numbers be thinned so they will keep to themselves. This witch uses a cold blast in combat.

Sirana Iceshriek is a named harpy whom Glorthal Stiffbeard identifies as the one spurring her kind to greater aggression. He reports that a stormrider spotted her circling the peak northwest of Frosthold and sends the player to kill her, expecting her attacks to subside afterward. In combat, she strikes with her talons and an icy shriek.

Gretta the Arbiter is a vrykul woman in Brunnhildar Village who speaks of serving Thorim and addresses the player as a sister or brother. She treats drake-riding as a noble tradition, calls the Valkyrion vrykul traitors for raising plagued proto-drakes, and insists that strength and discipline be demonstrated among her people. She recognizes the player's prowess while expecting continued commitment and defense of the Hyldskvinnar title.
A proto-drake associated with the Hyldsmeet.

Bouldercrag the Rockshaper is an Earthen defender at Bouldercrag’s Refuge, fighting Loken’s stormforged and seeking aid to protect his people. He calls Brann Bronzebeard their closest ally among the flesh and describes their struggle as brotherhood. He fears the refuge’s defenses will fail without reinforcements and sees Valduran’s weapon project as a threat to them.

SCRAP-E is a mechanical maintenance construct designated to care for the Inventor’s Library consoles and databases during Keeper Mimir’s absence. Its last maintenance cycle was 489 days ago; its current task is repairing the prototype console.
A young stormcrest drake that attacks with a swoop when fighting.
A Son of Hodir, this humanoid is found in the Storm Peaks. Its behavior includes a periodic club throw.
A wounded Frostborn Scout lies in the Storm Peaks, struggling to stand when approached. The scout's conversation concerns returning to Frosthold.

Astrid Bjornrittar is a bear trainer and servant of Thorim in Brunnhildar Village. She seeks a surviving wild bear matriarch, regards the jormungar as enemies of Thorim, and trains a novice to ride and fight with a warbear. Her teasing mixes encouragement with blunt humor; she calls the trainee “sister” or “brother.”
A Stormforged Loreseeker is a humanoid found in the Storm Peaks. In combat it uses Lightning Shield and Lightning Fury.
An Icebound Revenant is an undead creature found in the Storm Peaks. In combat it uses Avalanche.
Frozen Orb is an elemental in the Storm Peaks.
A Stormcrest Eagle, this creature is found in the Storm Peaks. It uses its talons in combat.

Khaliisi is a hunter and the owner of Frostbite, a tracking cat. After the crash, she was sent to hunt for food and is asked to lend Frostbite to help track Brann Bronzebeard. She objects to Boktar volunteering her companion, but accepts the errand because it is important.

Frostbite is Khaliisi's pet cat, valued for her keen scent and ability to track prey through snow. Khaliisi lends her to help follow Brann's trail; Frostbite can locate the target, while the traveler must handle what follows.
A Stormforged Monitor is a creature in the Storm Peaks. It periodically casts an aura and uses another spell in combat.
Icemane Yetis are creatures found in the Storm Peaks. They use a crashing slam in combat.

Mildred the Cruel runs the Forlorn Mine's coerced vrykul labor operation. She orders exhausted male workers beaten into compliance and calls for Garhal's execution to deter rebellion. She also gives the key to a female prisoner who claimed the right to compete in the Hyldsmeet, asking that her release be painless.
Smilin' Slirk Brassknob is an innkeeper whose welcome comes with a joke about the stove that has not exploded yet today. His inn also has a seasonal trick-or-treat interaction.
Grillix Bonesaw is a butcher who offers goods for visitors to browse.
Heksi is a stable master whose greeting offers help with pet stabling and recovering lost companions. Her service menu presents stabling and lost-companion recovery as separate options.
Xark Bolthammer supplies blacksmithing and engineering goods. His services also include repairs, and visitors can browse his stock.
Plip Fatpurse is a general-goods vendor. Visitors can browse his goods.
Nilika Blastbeaker sells poisons, reagents, and alchemical supplies; visitors can browse her goods.
K3 Bruisers are combatants that use Shoot and cast Net on nearby targets.
The Dead Iron Giant is a broken corpse from which Stormforged dwarves can pour out when it is struck by a spell.
Corig the Cunning sells poisons and reagents; visitors can browse his goods.
Dagni Oregleam supplies blacksmithing goods and offers repairs; visitors can browse her goods.
Brandig is a Grand Master Blacksmithing Trainer. His work centers on teaching blacksmithing.
Rutner Steelpick is a General Goods merchant who offers ammunition among his wares.
Gunda Boldhammer is an innkeeper who welcomes patrons to fill a tankard, pull up a chair, share stories and empty kegs. The inn also offers a home and goods, making Gunda a host as well as a vendor.

Moteha Windborn is a shaman at the Grom'arsh Crash-Site who believes the crash can teach its survivors something. Moteha seeks stormriders' voices to help make sense of Brann's speech, drawing on the wind's power to carry languages. Moteha's work is tied to the effort to understand Brann.
Warsong Hold Grunt is a humanoid grunt associated by name with the Hold; its combat behavior includes Mortal Strike.
Peon Gakra keeps an inn and supplies. He frames an inn as support for making new lands theirs: a place for battle-weary travelers to rest and share stories.
Marksman Udabu is a gunsmith who offers goods to browse. His name and trade identify him as a marksman as well as a practical source of firearms.
Apothecary Maple deals in poisons and reagents. The apothecary title and specialized stock make her a distinct supplier of alchemical materials.
Boarmaster Bragh tends stable services. He greets visitors and offers help with stabling pets or recovering lost companions, making his work about keeping travelers reunited with their animals.
Breck Rockbrow is a flight master offering fast travel.
Shavalius the Fancy is a flight master offering fast travel.
A tundra ram of the Borean Tundra, this is an animal encountered as a creature rather than a town service.
Andurg Slatechest is a stable master who helps travelers stable pets and recover lost companions.
An Earthen Stoneguard is an armed earthen combatant encountered in the Snowdrift Plains. It shoots at range and uses a net against nearby foes.
Brangrimm is a poisons and reagents merchant. Like other vendors, Brangrimm offers a goods-browsing service.
Horgoru the Collector is a general-goods vendor, with the collector title distinguishing this merchant by name.
Magorn welcomes weary travelers to the inn as its innkeeper and offers goods for browsing.
Dargum Hammerdeep is identified with blacksmithing supplies and offers both goods for browsing and repairs. His role centers on smithing materials and maintaining gear.
Udoho Icerunner is a stable master whose greeting addresses adventurers directly and describes help with stabling pets and recovering lost companions.
Hapanu Coldwind is associated with poisons and reagents.
Ontak is identified as a blacksmithing-supplies merchant and has both goods for browsing and a repair service. His role involves smithing materials and gear maintenance.

Danho Farcloud is a general-goods merchant whose stock includes ammunition. His role serves broad everyday needs, with ammunition as a specific offering that distinguishes his goods from specialist supplies.

Wabada Whiteflower is an innkeeper whose greeting welcomes visitors with a plains-and-wind image. Her inn offers a place to make their home and goods; the seasonal trick-or-treat interaction adds a festive note to her public-facing role.
An elite Tunka'lo warrior, the Brave uses Ground Slam in combat.

Lok'lira is an elderly woman imprisoned after seeking to enter the Hyldsmeet, a contest among Hyldnir. Aware that she is too old and frail to compete herself, she proposes that the player take part; her plan is tied to restoring Thorim to his rightful place.
A fallen Frostborn warrior.
An Iron Dwarf Assailant encountered in the Terrace of the Makers area. Thorim’s call to reclaim the Terrace targets Iron Dwarves.
An Iron Dwarf spellcaster, this magus uses Chain Lightning in combat.
An Earthen Elite, a level-80 combatant encountered in the area. Its combat routine uses Torn Earth.
An Earthen Warder found in the area, whose combat routine casts Lava Burst when a target is within range.
An Iron Sentinel serving Loken, encountered in the area. This powerful construct uses Stomp when a target comes within range.
Frostfang is Heksi’s pet, a creature encountered in the area.
Shardtooth is Udoho’s pet, a creature found in the area.
Snorts is Bragh’s pet, a level-79 creature encountered in the area. Its combat routine uses Boar Charge when it becomes aggressive.

Iva the Vengeful is a Hyldnir loyal to Thorim who condemns those of her people who joined the Lich King. She is especially hostile to Yulda, whom she blames for bringing the Lich King’s promises to their village and insulting Hyldsmeet traditions; she also calls the val’kyr traitors and urges punishment for them.
A cave-explosion helper tied to Gino’s plan to collapse Frostgut’s cave. It removes the “Collapsing Cave” aura when out of combat.
Blackmaw is identified as Andurg’s pet, a named beast encountered in the Storm Peaks.
Gnarlhide leads a gnoll group camped in Snowblind Hills. Ricket says their raids for parts have reached K3 and singles Gnarlhide out as the problem’s target.
Lodge-Matron Embla is an innkeeper who welcomes Battle-Sisters to feast and rest, and offers an inn-home service and goods. Her greeting frames food and sleep as preparation for battle.
Warsmith Sigfinna is an arms-and-armor smith who sells goods and offers repairs.
Kari the Beastmaster is a stable master whose duties include stabling pets and helping their owners recover lost companions.
Fylla Ingadottir sells poisons and reagents.
Sigdis the Trader deals in general goods and ammunition.

Victorious Challengers are opponents in the contest to defend the Hyldskvinnar title. Their own taunts challenge an opponent's worth and invoke Thorim; Gretta's quest describes the new challengers as would-be claimants to that title.
Stormcrest Eagles are elite beasts of the Storm Peaks.

A Fallen Earthen Defender is a wounded defender of Bouldercrag’s Refuge, where the earthen struggle against an iron onslaught. Bouldercrag seeks to heal the fallen and return them to battle. The defender expresses gratitude after fearing doom and offers to fight beside a helper against the irons.
An elemental called Eternal Watcher in The Storm Peaks.

Thyra Kvinnshal of Brunnhildar Village defends her people’s traditions against Scourge corruption. She reports that they dismembered the Lich King’s emissaries, while the sisters in Valkyrion accepted his overtures and began raising blighted drakes instead of capturing wild ones. Thyra asks for the diseased eggs to be destroyed with frost oil, treating the preservation of valiant traditions as essential.

Yulda the Stormspeaker is accused by Iva the Vengeful of bringing the Lich King’s promises of power to Brunnhildar Village and insulting its traditions. Iva describes Yulda as a witch whose strong magic let her escape, and seeks her death in Valkyrion.

Creteus is a keeper who watches over the Engine of the Makers and weighs whether visitors deserve his help. He questions why the traveler seeks Norgannon’s Core, then agrees to assist Brann Bronzebeard after hearing his purpose. Creteus is troubled by the contested fate of Thorim and the absence of knowledge about the other watchers; he asks the traveler to examine their temples. Drom regards him as a keeper whose omissions may conceal the Core, while Creteus calls Drom a noble, inquisitive dwarf.
A Stormforged combatant, the Warmonger uses Lightning Charged and Stormstrike in battle.
A Stormforged mechanical combatant, the Decimator attacks with Storm Punch.
The Iron Behemoth is a powerful combatant that uses Thunderous Stomp in battle.
A Frostborn Axemaster humanoid in The Storm Peaks.

Creteus is a named quest-giver at the Foot Steppes near the Engine of the Makers. He works to keep the iron dwarves occupied while King Stormheart and his men return to Frosthold, though he doubts he can hold them long. He directs the effort to recover Norgannon's Core and warns that the Forge of Wills is creating an army, making Ulduar unsafe.

Njormeld is a named quest-giver whom King Jokkum sent to recover Fjorn's Anvil and who is authorized to reforge the armor once gifted to Thorim. He is arranging to cool the anvil and asks for help guiding the aging but proud Snorri against fire revenants. Njormeld honors Snorri's past as a mighty warrior and plans to report the player's aid to the king.

King Jokkum leads his people at Dun Niffelem. He wants to mend their hearts and renew their friendship with Thorim after their ties were severed, and sees the defeat of Fjorn as a step toward reconciliation. He grieves the apparent loss of Thorim and vows that Loken will pay; later, he says Volkhan's defeat will help his people forgive Thorim.
A seething revenant found in the Storm Peaks. It casts a spell in combat.
A frost giant called Stormherald, encountered in the Storm Peaks.
Snorri is a named giant in the Storm Peaks.

Njormeld is a smith of the Sons of Hodir, trusted with work for King Jokkum and the stronghold. He develops protective relics and forges armor, and treats the Horn of Hodir and Hodir's Helm as sacred gifts, visibly moved when they are returned. He voices uncertainty about whether his people can rekindle their former affection for Thorim.
A restless Frostborn warrior encountered in the Frostborn lands.
A Stormforged soldier encountered in the Stormforged region.

The Iron Watcher is a singular challenge opponent. When its eyes are struck, it reels and charges blindly; another blow sends it off balance. These moments make the Watcher a formidable trial for Frostborn warriors proving themselves in battle.
A restless Frostborn ghost encountered among the Frostborn dead. Its name marks it as a lingering spirit of the Frostborn.

An exhausted male vrykul enslaved in the Forlorn Mine, he resents being treated like a beast and would rather die fighting than live as a slave. Though forced back to work, he vows that the vrykul will seek revenge.
Garhal is a male vrykul whom Mildred the Cruel identifies as the ringleader spreading rumors of insurrection among the mine's enslaved males. He urges others to attack when combat begins.
An infesting jormungar found around the Forlorn Mine, this creature attacks with a bite when drawn into combat.
An elemental called Orb Lightning, found in the Storm Peaks around Brunnhildar Village.

Bruor Ironbane is an earthen craftsman who once served the keepers at Ulduar. After Loken's betrayal, he turned to fighting the Stormforged, leading raids on Nidavelir and urging allies to strike their stronghold. He works with Bouldercrag to halt their advance, while recognizing that the iron dwarves resemble the people he once served.

Agnetta Tyrsdottar is a Hyldnir challenger at the Hyldsmeet. She meets a challenge with a fearless “bring it on” and regards the goblin at the mines as a mere warm-up for battle, showing dismissive, combative confidence.
A brittle revenant is an undead combatant in the Storm Peaks that attacks with Mace Smash.
A dead iron giant is a fallen giant in the Storm Peaks whose broken corpse can disgorge Stormforged dwarves.
A worg of the Cavedweller caves, represented by a population rather than a single named individual.

Gimorak is a formidable worg in his den. Tracker Val’zij calls him the meanest worg he has seen and blames him for killing his wind serpent, Heesha; Val’zij seeks revenge. Gimorak attacks with gore and leaps at nearby foes.
A smoldering scrap bunny that casts a spell.
A mechanical mechagnome attendant found in the Storm Peaks, identified by its attendant role rather than an individual name.
Hyldsmeet Warbears are opponents in the Pit of the Fang, where Brunnhildar trainees test themselves against bear riders. Astrid presents the bouts as a challenge fought on equal footing.
A ravaged Cavedweller worg, represented by a small population in the same cave area where Gimorak is found.
Yorg Stormheart bears the title King of the Frostborn and fights with Avatar and Thunderclap.
A Scion of Storm is an elemental that attacks with a kinetic beam and releases Zephyr when it dies.
Attendant Tock serves in Keeper Mimir's workshop and can analyze metal specimens. It identifies an unfamiliar sample as an alloy of saronite and iron.
A phase-two helper in Dun Niffelem's spear-chain sequence.

Bloodguard Lorga is trying to keep the stranded survivors alive through the mountain cold. With their wreckage wood running low, she asks for worg furs and gives the searcher a flare in case the pack surrounds them. She also warns that a hunter sent to the den has not returned and asks for Tracker Val'zij to be brought back if possible.

Lorekeeper Randvir says Hodir revealed the secret of a great artifact in a vision and treats the work as sacred prophecy. He calls for Everfrost Shards and Stoic Mammoth hides to make Hodir's Spear, warning that doom would follow if they fail to receive this gift.
A mammoth in the Valley of Ancient Winters; its hide is among the materials Lorekeeper Randvir seeks for Hodir's Spear.
Son of Hodir is a figure found in the Valley of Ancient Winters and Dun Niffelem.
A Wild Wyrm is a wild dragonkin that swipes with its claws. It shrieks in pain, twists around and seizes an opponent in its mouth.
A Ravenous Jormungar is a hungry beast.

The Frostworg Denmother of Dun Niffelem senses danger outside the stronghold and communicates through growls and sharp quips that a trusted visitor seems able to understand. She drops a chain bearing an aged fang at the visitor’s feet as a way to oppose hidden spies. Her reward response portrays her approvingly licking the helper’s face when the chain is returned.

Thorim blames his brother Loken for killing his wife and turning his followers against him. He regrets years of neglect and self-pity, admires the earthen defenders' steadfast oath, and rallies them to reclaim the Terrace of the Makers. Determined to face Loken personally, he asks allies to witness rather than aid the confrontation and report its outcome to his trusted friend, King Jokkum.
The Iron Colossus is an iron construct completed for battle on the Snowdrift Plains. Its armor is vulnerable to jormungar acid, and it attacks with Ground Slam.

A tamed jormungar used against the Iron Colossus on the Snowdrift Plains. Orbs let the player take control of one; its acid can penetrate the colossus's armor. Nearby handlers can help with controlling the creature.
A battlescarred frostworg in the Storm Peaks, this hostile beast bears the scars of battle.
An Earthen jormungar handler in the Storm Peaks.

Eisenfaust is a giant and one of Loken's powerful lieutenants, serving in the Hall of the Shaper. Thorim names him among the servants sent in Loken's attack on the Terrace of the Makers and calls for his defeat; Eisenfaust uses a stomping attack in combat.

Duronn is a named servant of Loken and one of the powerful lieutenants sent against the Terrace of the Makers. Thorim places him deeper in the Terrace, beyond the northwest stairs. In combat, Duronn stomps and can cast Reconstruction when badly wounded.

Elder Fargal is a named elder whose words mark the new year and bright moon as the time when the ancients awaken. He welcomes homage to the olden races and offers a token in return. His gossip directs visitors seeking Elder Yurauk, Elder Stonebeard, Elder Muraco or Elder Graymane.
Elder Graymane is a named elder whose words look back on a time when “we” hunted for glory and honor, then ask whether the present is so different. In response to homage, he offers a token in return.
Elder Muraco is a named elder whose words look back on a time when “we” hunted for glory and honor, then ask whether the present is so different. In response to homage, he offers a token in return.

Elder Stonebeard is one of the olden-race elders honored in Northrend. His words describe the ancients awakening when the year is new and the moon shines bright. He can direct visitors asking about Elders Fargal, Yurauk, Muraco, and Graymane. In response to homage, he thanks a visitor for honoring the olden races and offers a token.

Halefnir the Windborn bears the title “Servant of Loken.” Thorim identifies him among Loken’s powerful lieutenants and names him as a target in the campaign against Loken’s forces at the Terrace of the Makers. He casts Chain Lightning in combat.

Xarantaur, the Witness, was granted immortality by the Bronze Dragonflight and entrusted with the Lorehammer by Nozdormu. He investigates why Stormhoof's story is disappearing from the memories and records of Tunka'lo, fearing the hero's legacy could be lost. He works to identify where history was altered and restore the true timeline, recognizing that the North Wind's minions can attack both stories and the spirits of the honored dead.

Brann Bronzebeard has traveled the world more than once, yet the prospect of completing Norgannon's keystone fills him with fresh excitement. At the Engine of the Makers, he seeks the core needed to combine it and eagerly praises allies' discoveries. Despite his admiration for the artifact, he prioritizes escaping the iron dwarves and asks companions to cover his flying machine on the way to Frosthold.
Brann's Flying Machine is a flying machine associated with Brann.
Seething Revenants cast Seething Flames even while out of combat.

Thorim regrets the harm his grief brought to those closest to him and asks King Jokkum to forgive the suffering he caused him and his people. He values Jokkum's help with Krolmir, whose survival he had scarcely dared hope for, and is eager to take the hammer into battle. He is determined to face his brother Loken's forces at the Terrace of the Makers and appreciates allies' honorable service.

Chieftain Swiftspear is a taunka chieftain whose memories have been clouded by the disturbances at the warriors' tomb. He remembers that his brother Stormhoof was a greater warrior, left in search of a horn, and faced a terrible pursuer after winning it, but cannot recall what happened next. The uncertainty about his brother troubles him.

Loken uses deception to turn others to his purposes, boasting that a mortal unwittingly served him after being fooled by an illusion. He mocks his brother's attachment to Sif and admits his brother can best him in a fair fight, but seeks an advantage by drawing the confrontation closer to his master's power. He orders his brother and the riding drake taken away, insisting that the broodmother survive for plans he does not disclose.
Thorim believes he has avoided his destiny too long and must personally destroy Loken. He resolves to end his brother's madness, calls Loken a traitor, and challenges him to stand and fight.

Velog Icebellow is a Frostborn storyteller whose account centers on his father's party. During a blizzard in Dragonblight, they found and sheltered a wounded, amnesiac mountain dwarf; when a jormungar attacked, the dwarf transformed and killed it. Velog presents the tale as a defining encounter between Frostborn and a stranger from another kind of dwarf.
Veranus is a dragonkin who casts Ethereal Teleport.
Roaming Jormungar are roaming beasts.
Ice Steppe Bulls are wild animals of the region. This bull charges with Rhino Charge when it becomes aggressive, a distinctive response beyond its ordinary animal role.
Romping Rhino is a beast that uses its Romp ability in combat.
Wailing Winds is an elemental creature that casts Squall at foes within range.
Frostfloe Deep Stalker is identified by its Frostfloe habitat and deep-stalking role.
Oloh is a named beast and an elite opponent.

“Honest” Max runs a used flying-mount loan service, offering mounts at no cost and saying local goblins pay him to lend them to others. His casual greeting gives little away about whether his nickname is deserved.

Tracker Val'zij is one of the hunters sent into the Storm Peaks and is found badly weakened after a jormungar toxin leaves him numb. He asks for a toxin gland and cave mushrooms to slow it while he makes an antidote. Once recovering, he says his wind serpent Heesha was killed by the worg Gimorak; revenge matters to him, though he admits the antidote may be helping too.

Olut Alegut welcomes travelers to the Storm Peaks and trades rewards for relics from ancient Ulduar, sometimes offering potent ale as thanks. He speaks with dry humor about the expedition's failed attempt to gain a foothold toward Icecrown, and considers reaching the region from another direction instead.

The North Wind is an elemental enemy remembered in the Tunka'lo account of Stormhoof, whose battle with it is part of the taunka's history. In combat, it boasts that no one will defeat it and threatens anyone who would use the Horn of Elemental Fury against its side. Its speech presents it as a dangerous opponent.
A disturbed taunka ancestor in The Storm Peaks.
Creteus is in The Storm Peaks.
The Iron Behemoth is a humanoid found in The Storm Peaks.

The Guardian's Charge is a quest-giving presence associated with the search for Norgannon's Core and “Fury of the Frostborn King.” The Core rests in an old chest, with heavy footsteps approaching amid distant fighting.
The Stormforged Amplifier is a mechanical Stormforged combatant that casts Lightning Bolt when fighting.

Roxi Ramrocket is a Cold Weather Flying Trainer who also sells goods. Her fixer’s outlook comes through in the line, “Just because something isn't broke doesn't mean you can't fix it,” delivered with a cheeky “sweety.”
A Stormforged Saboteur is a humanoid combatant named for its sabotage role and Stormforged identity.
The Ancient Sentinel is a mechanical guardian with a combat role: it can cast Stomp and Trample when fighting.
Athan is a named mechanical being.

Brann Bronzebeard seeks to combine Norgannon's Shell and Core into a keystone at the Temple of Invention. He is eager to discover the unknown secrets of Ulduar's archives and credits his companions' help with advancing the search for the key.
A Copperpot Goon is a humanoid in the Storm Peaks.
Chester Copperpot is a general and trade supplies vendor. He offers goods and provides repairs.
Slosh is a food and drink vendor, with an option to browse goods.
A rare, hostile proto-drake that roams the Storm Peaks as a powerful wild creature.
Dirkee is a powerful hostile machine encountered in the Storm Peaks. In combat, it attacks with Mechano Kick and Suppressive Fire.

Lillehoff serves as the Sons of Hodir's quartermaster and tends their trade and tribute traditions. He describes tribute as a continuation of offerings made to Hodir for his strength and wisdom, and says he judges people by courage and loyalty rather than stature.
The remains of a fallen worg in the Storm Peaks: the body of a dead beast.
Halvdan is a flight master in the Storm Peaks who offers fast travel. When attacked, he summons an Enraged Gryphon and an Enraged Wyvern.

Calder sells blacksmithing supplies in Dun Niffelem and treasures Everfrost as a symbol of his people's heart. He attributes its scarcity to jormungar consuming the once-abundant ice over the ages. Grateful for recovered pieces, he asks travelers to return any more they find.
Vyragosa is a dragonkin in The Storm Peaks.
The Storm Peaks Flame Warden tends the festival flame associated with Alliance settlements. He urges visitors to honor Alliance fires and desecrate Horde fires, expressing clear Alliance allegiance.
The Storm Peaks Flame Keeper tends the festival flame associated with Horde settlements. He urges visitors to honor Horde fires and desecrate Alliance fires, expressing clear Horde allegiance.
Skoll is a beast that uses Pounce and Frozen Bite in combat.

place_records.text: You are in The Storm Peaks, a frozen, contested land in Northrend where both the Alliance and the Horde hold settlements. Frosthold is Alliance, Grom'arsh Crash-Site and Camp Tunka'lo are Horde, and K3, Dun Niffelem, Ulduar and Bouldercrag's Refuge stand with neither side. Jormungars, icemaw bears, yetis and stormpeak wyrms roam the peaks, and Loken's stormforged fight across the land.

You are in K3, a camp in The Storm Peaks that neither side holds. Ricket coordinates its sapper squad and teleporter, and Jeer Sparksocket lays land mines for her. Its inn serves visitors, while magnataur from the northeast press toward the camp and the goblin Zeev Fizzlespark is still missing in the Forlorn Mine.

You are in Snowblind Hills, a stretch of The Storm Peaks near K3. Savage Hill brutes, snowblind diggers and icemane yetis roam it. Tore Rumblewrench, who heads K3's mining operation, wants the spiders of Crystalweb Cavern cleared before his crews move in.
You are in Snowblind Terrace, a stretch of The Storm Peaks. Icemane yetis, crystalweb spitters and weavers, snowblind diggers and snowblind devotees roam it.

You are in Garm, a stretch of The Storm Peaks where K3's sappers have set up defenses against Garm invaders. Garm watchers and snowblind followers hold the ground, and ironwool mammoths are also here.

You are in Brunnhildar Village, a Hyldnir settlement in The Storm Peaks where the Hyldsmeet, a competition of Hyldnir against Hyldnir, is under way. Brunnhildar challengers and riding bears are its main dangers, and Iva the Vengeful is among them. Lok'lira the Crone, a prisoner, and the goblin Zeev Fizzlespark are caught up in the contest.

You are in Sifreldar Village, a Hyldnir village in The Storm Peaks overlooking K3. Sifreldar storm maidens, runekeepers and crystalweb spiders are its dangers. The Forlorn Mine in its north is where prisoners from K3's expedition are made to work, and Zeev Fizzlespark is still missing there.
You are in Valkyrion, a part of The Storm Peaks haunted by nascent val'kyr and valkyrion aspirants. Yulda the Stormspeaker is among the hostile ones, and blighted proto-drakes prowl the area.

You are in Frosthold, an Alliance settlement in The Storm Peaks led by Yorg Stormheart, king of the Frostborn. Its inn and flight master serve visitors. Harpies keep attacking the Frostborn, and several Frostborn scouts have gone missing in the valleys to the east.

You are in Grom'arsh Crash-Site, a Horde camp in The Storm Peaks built around the wreck of a zeppelin. Bloodguard Lorga keeps the stranded survivors alive through the mountain cold, and Boktar Bloodfury is searching for Brann Bronzebeard, who has vanished. Its inn serves travelers.

You are in Temple of Storms, a temple in The Storm Peaks where Thorim, grieving for Sif, plans to reclaim the Terrace of the Makers from his brother Loken. Stormforged artificers and mechagnome laborers are the hostile forces around it.
You are in Engine of the Makers, a great pit in The Storm Peaks where Brann Bronzebeard seeks to combine Norgannon's keystone. Stormforged soldiers are its danger.

You are in The Foot Steppes, a hard land of The Storm Peaks. The keeper Creteus watches over the Engine of the Makers nearby, and Ice Steppe rhinos roam it. Stormpeak wyrms, iron behemoths and stormforged warmongers are the chief dangers here.
You are in Dragonspine Peaks, a part of the Storm Peaks. Stormpeak hatchlings and Stormpeak wyrms are hostile here and make the ground dangerous.

You are in Nidavelir, a part of the Storm Peaks where Stormforged champions, magi, war golems and taskmasters are hostile. Valduran the Stormborn is among them. A captive mechagnome laborer here is under Stormforged control and still echoes its orders to shut down, return to the Inventor's Library, or help defeat the iron dwarves.

You are in Narvir's Cradle, a part of the Storm Peaks where Stormforged artificers, war golems and stormriders are hostile. An earthen defender, an earthbound guardian whose role is defense, is here too.

You are in Snowdrift Plains, a part of the Storm Peaks with a spirit healer. A tamed jormungar, used against the Iron Colossus on the Snowdrift Plains, is found here, and earthen jormungar handlers nearby can help control it. Stormforged raiders and reavers, stormriders and snowdrift jormungar are hostile here.

You are in the Valley of Ancient Winters, a part of the Storm Peaks. Roaming jormungar, brunnhildar warbears, frigid proto-drakes, wild wyrms and icemaw bears are hostile here. Niffelem frost giants are found here as well.

You are in Dun Niffelem, the Sons of Hodir stronghold in the Storm Peaks, with a flight master and a vendor. King Jokkum leads his people here and grieves the apparent loss of Thorim. Njormeld, a smith trusted with the stronghold's work, forges armor and relics, and Calder sells blacksmithing supplies.
You are in Frostfield Lake, a part of the Storm Peaks. Seething revenants, brittle revenants, dead iron giants and stormforged iron giants are hostile here, and tundra rams roam too.
You are in Thunderfall, a part of the Storm Peaks. Restless frostborn warriors and ghosts, niffelem forefathers and tundra rams are hostile here. Dirkee is also hostile here.

You are in Camp Tunka'lo, a Horde camp in the Storm Peaks, with an inn, stables and a wind rider master. Xarantaur the Witness, granted immortality by the Bronze Dragonflight, is investigating why the story of the hero Stormhoof is vanishing from the camp's records. Ontak sells blacksmithing supplies.
You are in Brann's Base-Camp, in the Storm Peaks, where Stormforged saboteurs are hostile.

You are in the Plain of Echoes, a part of the Storm Peaks. Scions of storm, plains mammoths, romping rhinos and wailing winds are hostile here, and the North Wind is too. A disturbed taunka ancestor is also found here.

You are in Ulduar, a part of the Storm Peaks with a flight master, repairs and a spirit healer. Chester Copperpot sells general and trade supplies. Thorim is here, resolved to destroy his brother Loken and calling him a traitor. Veranus is hostile here.

You are in the Terrace of the Makers, a place in the Storm Peaks. Thorim rallies the earthen defenders here to reclaim the ground from his brother Loken, whose iron dwarves still fight across it. Infesting Jormungar and Iron Dwarf Assailants are the dangers, and a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. A Horde hunter, Tracker Val'zij, was left badly weakened by a jormungar sting.

You are in Bor's Fall, a place in the Storm Peaks. A wounded Frostborn Scout, an Alliance scout, lies here struggling to get back to Frosthold. Savage Hill scavengers, mystics and brutes roam the ground with Frostfeather witches, and young stormcrest hatchlings attack with a swoop.

You are in Bor's Breath in the Storm Peaks, where a spirit healer offers a return to life for a price. Frostfeather witches and screechers are the main danger here, along with a time-lost proto drake and Vyragosa.

You are in Rohemdal Pass in the Storm Peaks. Frostfeather screechers and witches, along with Stormforged loreseekers and pillagers, make the pass dangerous. Stormcrest eagles, elite beasts of the Storm Peaks that stand with the Alliance, are found here, and young stormcrest hatchlings attack with a swoop.

You are in Sparksocket Minefield in the Storm Peaks. Sparksocket AA Cannon turrets guard the ground, and Savage Hill scavengers roam here. Janks is stuck watching the turrets, weary and frustrated, and still hopes someone will come to free him.

You are in Garm's Bane in the Storm Peaks, where Snowblind followers and Garm invaders are the danger. Improved land mines, explosive traps that go off when a victim comes close, are hidden in the ground here.

You are in Garm's Rise in the Storm Peaks. Gino, an explosives specialist who delights in his blasts, is planning an assault on Frostgut's cave, and goblin sappers work with him. Snowblind devotees are the danger here.

You are in The Frigid Tomb in the Storm Peaks, where an Alliance Frostborn Axemaster is found. Icebound revenants and frozen orbs are the dangers, along with Stormforged warmongers and decimators and an iron behemoth.

You are in Bouldercrag's Refuge in the Storm Peaks. Breck Rockbrow offers fast flights from here, and Magorn keeps the inn. Andurg Slatechest helps travelers stable pets and recover lost companions, and his pet Blackmaw, a named beast, is found nearby.

You are in The Inventor's Library in the Storm Peaks, a place of mechanical devices. Library Guardians are the danger here. Mimir hid information in the databanks, and an Inventor's Disk can retrieve hidden data from the Databank Core.

You are in Fjorn's Anvil in the Storm Peaks. King Jokkum sent Njormeld to recover the anvil, and he is cooling it so it can be taken home. Seething revenants and Stormforged iron giants are the danger, along with the giant Fjorn. The aging giant Snorri still joins every fight he can.
You are in The Blighted Pool in the Storm Peaks, where nascent val'kyr, blighted proto-drakes and Valkyrion aspirants are the danger.

You are in The Forlorn Mine, a mine in the Storm Peaks. The Hyldnir keep enslaved vrykul here, and Mildred the Cruel drives them hard. Garhal is stirring talk of revolt among the enslaved males, while Hyldnir overseers patrol the tunnels. Lok'lira the Crone, a Yrkvinn illusion practitioner, is imprisoned here.

You are in Crystalweb Cavern, a cave in the Storm Peaks. Crystalweb weavers, spitters and snowblind diggers infest its passages. An injured goblin miner lies poisoned by a spider's bite, and Ricket at K3 could brew him an antidote from an icetip venom sac.

You are in Gimorak's Den, a cave in the Storm Peaks. Cavedweller worgs and infesting jormungars haunt it. A Horde tracker named Val'zij lies weakened after a jormungar stung him, and his wind serpent was killed by Gimorak.
